title: tsfore results site: choose the visual world (re-roll)
question: The re-roll assigned the Market Terminal. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Market Terminal
options.lineage: 1990s financial terminals: amber-on-black panes, function-key commands
options.thesis: The models are run like securities: each family gets a ticker pane, each series a quote line, and findings print as terminal news.
options.viewport: A command bar (TSFR <GO>) over three side-by-side family panes, STATS / TIMESTRAL / CHRONOS-2, each with rel_MASE, rel_WQL and coverage, with a scrolling findings tape beneath.
options.risk: Can read as a finance costume over an ML result; prose must stay readable, not all-caps mono.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: fixed-scale botanical plates through the seasons
options.thesis: Each of 11 series a plate at one fixed scale; the three families drawn side by side on every plate.
options.case: Fixed-scale plates are honest small multiples; fuses well, but cream plates edge toward the default look.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: Side A finance, Side B pairs; findings as a timed tracklist, corrections inked over.
options.case: Charming and the strike-through corrections fit; fuses poorly because dense tables fight hand lettering.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: Each model a node held by tension cords whose thickness is effect size and p-value.
options.case: Fuses poorly because structural forces map loosely onto forecast errors and hurt clarity.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An ML benchmark results page: leaderboard table, bar charts, findings and methodology.
canonCard.viewport: Title and one-line verdict over a sortable leaderboard, charts below.
canonCard.risk: Familiar to the point of forgettable.
